svg.title: HospitalSystem database schema
svg.desc: The Neon PostgreSQL database neondb, schema public, as EF Core migrations built it. Departments have many Doctors; each Doctor is one User; Doctors have many Calendars and Appointments; Patients have many Appointments; each Appointment records the front-desk User who created it. Every foreign key is ON DELETE RESTRICT. A partial unique index stops two Scheduled appointments for the same doctor and time. AuditLogs and __EFMigrationsHistory have no foreign keys.
